verdict.rationale: Copilot CLI (docs-26) lets you invoke Copilot from a terminal, and Copilot cloud agent 'Automations' (docs-15, docs-33) can be triggered on a schedule or repository events, which supports some non-interactive workflow automation. However, there is no direct evidence of a documented headless/non-interactive CLI flag (e.g., a scripted prompt-and-exit mode with exit codes) for running Copilot CLI itself inside arbitrary scripts. missing for 10: explicit CLI non-interactive/scripting mode docs, evidence of exit-code/output-parsing support for pipelines, independent hands-on confirmation of script usage.
